name: Putney's You pick berry
description: In 603 Love Road, MI, Putney's You pick berry raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
